subcategory_text: Detect, triage, respond to, and learn from security incidents in production with defined roles and SLAs.
implementation_examples: L1: Documented IR process and on-call rota
L2: Defined SLAs and playbook library
L3: Coordinated exercises with external parties and regulator reporting
assessment_objectives: Determine whether an incident response process exists.
Determine whether lessons learned feed back into improvements.
